text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, here is the report. Regarding the 
previous race... Orfevre took 1st place by 
a massive margin.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I truly wish you could have seen it too, 
Big Sis. Orfe's closing drive in the home 
stretch that left everyone in the dust... 
I haven't seen a turn of foot that sharp 
in recent memory.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...When's your next race? Maybe I'll come 
watch.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Did you just say you were going to watch 
it now? Orfe's race?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. You're in top form, right? I'm 
curious to see what level you're at right 
now.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Heh. You're finally coming, are you? I 
permit no broken promises before the King. 
You had best show up."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Rejoice. I shall grant thee the privilege 
of witnessing all creation kneel before 
me.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I'll make all the arrangements right away. 
Right in front of the goal would be best 
for you, Sis. You'll really be able to 
feel Orfe's spirit there.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"By the way... I'm scheduled to run with 
you after that. It's a bit embarrassing 
after seeing Orfevre run, but... If it's 
alright, could you give me some advice?"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind. Well, whether my opinion 
will be of any use is another question, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
You two are both far more respectable 
Umamusume than I am, after all.
